heading: Κεφ. ια΄. — CHAP. XI.
paragraphs:
Apostles and Prophets are described as mere evangelists, or
itinerant preachers, who were not expected to remain in one
place more than a single day.

P. 20, 1:218—εἰ μή has been inserted in the translation before
ἡμέραν. So Harnack, Theol. Lit. Zeit., Feb. 9, 1884. Ct. p. 22, I.246.
